Priya: I'll draft Dedicated + Private page copy. For Dedicated we should call out 'Dedicated capacity' and SLA; for Private emphasize 'VPC, KMS, audit logs'.
Evan: I'll wire the lead form and GTM tags. Routing rules: Hosted -> product-leads; Dedicated/Private -> enterprise SDR; Private -> needs_nda flag.
Maya: Sales wants an FAQ snippet for Dedicated (onboarding time, contract, support level). I'll draft 3 bullets.

Colin: Hosted blurb (short): "Hosted API for low-latency generation and simple billing."
Priya: Dedicated blurb: "Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput with SLA-backed performance."
Priya: Private blurb: "Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) with KMS integration, audit logs, and strict access controls."
Evan: Small form snippet I'll post in #devex: ```html
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"campaign\" value=\"launch-sprint\">
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"lead_bucket\" value=\"product\">
```
And JS: if(package==='private'){ set lead_bucket='enterprise'; show NDA checkbox; set needs_nda=true }
Maya: Dedicated FAQ bullets: 1) Onboarding: 2-3 weeks 2) Contracts: monthly/annual commits 3) Support: enterprise SLA options
Nina: Benchmark 1-pager needed for webinar: median latency, batching cost delta, quantization note. Evan can you attach by Thu?
Evan: Yes—will upload and share link.
DeployBot: Reminder: create webinar draft in Figma by Thu 9AM.
Nina: Action items: Colin Hosted+social (Wed EOD), Priya Dedicated/Private copy (Thu), Evan forms + benchmark link (Thu), Maya FAQ + MRR field copy (Wed). We'll review Friday afternoon.
